name: roda-program
description: Build and test scripts for the Roda NEAR contracts

scripts.build: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cargo build --manifest-path token/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cp -f token/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/roda_token.wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/roda_token.wasm
scripts.test: cargo test -p roda && cargo test -p roda-token && node scripts/test-logic.js
